intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: hurt is the verb, pain is the noun: My head hurts. / I have a pain in my back. Czech says bolí mě hlava for both.
intro.note_cz: hurt = sloveso (bolí), pain = podstatné jméno (bolest). Bolí mě hlava = My head hurts.

sentences.en: Good food is important for your health.
sentences.cz: Dobré jídlo je důležité pro tvoje zdraví.
accepts: Good food is important for your health
Good food is important for health

sentences.en: My father is healthy and strong.
sentences.cz: Můj otec je zdravý a silný.

sentences.en: My son is ill, so he is not at school.
sentences.cz: Můj syn je nemocný, tak není ve škole.
